summary: Onto Innovation Inc. filed an 8-K announcing plans for a private offering of $1.1B aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2031, under Rule 144A. The proceeds will be used for share repurchases and capped call transactions. No specific price per share, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. The offering is subject to market conditions. The mechanics include a convertible issuance alongside hedging via capped calls to reduce dilution. Watch: pricing terms, conversion premium, and overall capital return impact to equity value.
